description: Source code for Nuvoton NPCX tachometer sensor driver, implementing input capture and RPM measurement using hardware timers and external pins.

methods.name: tach_npcx_start_port_a
methods.description: Initializes and starts Timer A for tachometer port A, setting counter, capture register, edge detection, debounce, and clock source.

methods.name: tach_npcx_start_port_b
methods.description: Initializes and starts Timer B for tachometer port B, setting counter, capture register, edge detection, debounce, and clock source.

methods.name: tach_npcx_is_underflow
methods.description: Checks if the timer has underflowed (no edges detected) for the specified port.

methods.name: tach_npcx_clear_underflow_flag
methods.description: Clears the underflow flag for the specified port.

methods.name: tach_npcx_is_captured
methods.description: Checks if a capture event has occurred on the specified port.

methods.name: tach_npcx_clear_captured_flag
methods.description: Clears the capture event flag for the specified port.

methods.name: tach_npcx_get_captured_count
methods.description: Retrieves the captured timer count for the specified port.

methods.name: tach_npcx_configure
methods.description: Configures the tachometer hardware with mode, clock source, and sampling frequency.

methods.name: tach_npcx_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches the latest sample, handling underflow and capture flags, updating internal capture count.

methods.name: tach_npcx_channel_get
methods.description: Calculates RPM from captured counts and fills sensor_value structure.

methods.name: tach_npcx_init
methods.description: Initializes the tachometer device, enabling clock, configuring pins, setting mode, and starting timers.
